name: Homelab Service Health
description: Overall service health, incidents, latency, last check time, and a compact service list.
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Group justify="space-between" align="center"><Text fw={700}>Service health</Text><RefreshButton requestId="health" label="Refresh" /></Group>{status.health.loading ? <Text c="dimmed">Checking services…</Text> : status.health.error ? <Text c="red">Could not load service health</Text> : data.health ? <Stack gap="sm"><Card withBorder padding="sm"><Stack gap="xs"><Group justify="space-between" align="center"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Overall status</Text><Badge color={data.health.status === "operational" ? "green" : data.health.status === "degraded" ? "yellow" : "red"}>{data.health.status === "operational" ? "Operational" : data.health.status === "degraded" ? "Degraded" : "Unknown"}</Badge></Group><SimpleGrid cols={3} spacing="xs"><Stack gap={0}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Incidents</Text><Text fw={700}>{data.health.openIncidents ?? 0}</Text></Stack><Stack gap={0}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Latency</Text><Text fw={700}>{data.health.latencyMs ?? "—"} ms</Text></Stack><Stack gap={0}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Last check · UTC</Text><Text size="xs">{data.health.checkedAt ? Date.toLocaleString(data.health.checkedAt, "en-US", "UTC") : "—"}</Text></Stack></SimpleGrid></Stack></Card><Stack gap="xs"><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Services</Text>{(data.health.services ?? []).length > 0 ? (data.health.services ?? []).map(service => <Group key={service.id} justify="space-between" gap="xs" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="sm" style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }} lineClamp={1}>{service.name}</Text><Badge size="sm" color={service.status === "operational" ? "green" : service.status === "degraded" ? "yellow" : "red"}>{service.status === "operational" ? "Operational" : service.status === "degraded" ? "Degraded" : "Unknown"}</Badge><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{service.latencyMs ?? "—"} ms</Text></Group>) : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No services reported</Text>}</Stack></Stack> : <Text c="dimmed">No health data available</Text>}</Stack>
